notes: PeopleSoft Financials uses 'chartfields' — a flexible chart of accounts structure. The key chartfields for higher ed are: Business Unit, Account, Fund, Department, Program, Class, and Project. Institutions configure which chartfields are active. Fund accounting is critical for public institutions (GASB). The combination of chartfields on a journal line determines the full financial context of a transaction.
